settings.name: USE_LIMIT_REQ
settings.description: **Enable Request Limiting:** Set to `yes` to enable the request rate limiting feature.

settings.name: LIMIT_REQ_URL
settings.description: **URL Pattern:** URL pattern (PCRE regex) to which the rate limit will be applied; use `/` to apply for all requests.

settings.name: LIMIT_REQ_RATE
settings.description: **Rate Limit:** Maximum request rate in the format `Nr/t`, where N is the number of requests and t is the time unit: s (second), m (minute), h (hour), or d (day).

settings.name: USE_LIMIT_REQ_GLOBAL
settings.description: **Enable Global Rate Limiting:** Set to `yes` to cap the total aggregate request rate for the service (all clients, all URLs).

settings.name: LIMIT_REQ_GLOBAL_RATE
settings.description: **Global Rate Limit:** Maximum aggregate request rate in the format `Nr/t`, same syntax as `LIMIT_REQ_RATE`.

settings.name: USE_LIMIT_CONN
settings.description: **Enable Connection Limiting:** Set to `yes` to enable the connection limiting feature.

settings.name: LIMIT_CONN_MAX_HTTP1
settings.description: **HTTP/1.X Connections:** Maximum number of concurrent HTTP/1.X connections per IP address.

settings.name: LIMIT_CONN_MAX_HTTP2
settings.description: **HTTP/2 Streams:** Maximum number of concurrent HTTP/2 streams per IP address.

settings.name: LIMIT_CONN_MAX_HTTP3
settings.description: **HTTP/3 Streams:** Maximum number of concurrent HTTP/3 streams per IP address.

settings.name: LIMIT_CONN_MAX_STREAM
settings.description: **Stream Connections:** Maximum number of concurrent stream connections per IP address.
